The Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460)
Order under Section 39A (1)

The allotments specified in the Order No. 82 of 2013 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1802/14 dated 20th March 2013 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka are vested absolutely in the State and the possession of which have been taken for or on behalf of the State under Paragraph (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue of Powers vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39 (a) (inserted by Act, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby divest only the allotments specified in the Schedule I below.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/21.Acquisition Officer’s No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/08Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”,No. 1200/6,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.10th April, 2024.
